_comment: Economy and government types for inhabited planets (docs/MASTER_DESIGN.md sections 10-11). Government fields: 'illegal_goods' are contraband there; 'scan_chance' is the chance police scan you when you arrive; 'black_market_risk' is the chance a black-market deal gets busted; 'fine_rate' is the fine as a share of the contraband's value; 'prices' multiplies the price of some goods; 'fuel_price' is credits per unit of fuel; 'police' is how many police ships patrol a system with such a planet (the most of its planets; home systems get one more). Anarchies have no police and no law: crimes there only cost karma. 'law' (Milestone 5): fines and karma for crimes, fines shrink by 'fine_decay' per day (gone below 'min_fine'), pirates leave pilots with karma at or below 'pirate_friend_karma' alone, and 'reputation' names karma levels (the first entry whose 'min' you reach).
